kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتزاحم (form VI)
# نَتَزَاحَمُ (natazāḥamu) /na.ta.zaː.ħa.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# نَتَزَاحَمَ (natazāḥama) /na.ta.zaː.ħa.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
# نَتَزَاحَمْ (natazāḥam) /na.ta.zaː.ħam/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَاحَمَ (tazāḥama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
